athens_reforms_1.p: Strategoi: Honourable Archontes and Demos of Athens, we, the strategoi, propose to equip some of our soldiers with the oval Thureos shield. > > Demos: What? Why? The shield of the Galatians, these treacherous Barbarians?

athens_reforms_2.p: Strategos Erechteus: Dear people of Athens! Hear me out! I know that you love your coins, but today you have to part with some of your drachmai, for we can strengthen our armies! > > Demos: Booo!!!

bactria_reforms.p: Hail, Basileios! Together with our independence from the Seleucid Empire, the migration of Greek and Macedonian military settlers has also come to an end.

carthage_reforms_1.p: Who gets it: Carthage and Gades

carthage_reforms_2.p: Who gets it: Carthage and Gades

cyrene_reforms_1.p: Mighty Basileios, autokrator of Kyrene, we praise you! Under the guidance of Zeus himself, you have established ourselves among the great realms of the world.
r: Cyrene, Egyptians, Ptolemaic Empire, Ptolemaic Rebels

cyrene_reforms_2.p: Mighty Basileios, autokrator of Kyrene, by Zeus, be praised! You have led us to many a victory, like a true Hellenic heros.

epirus_reforms.p: Hail, Basileios! Over time, our soldiers have encountered and slain many foes. Among the barbarians we faced in Italy, we found cavalrymen hiding behind shields.

getae_reforms.p: Hail, my king! Over time, our soldiers have encountered and slain many foes.

gortyn_reforms.p: Aristocrats: Hear us, citizens of Gortyn! Our lands are prospering, and you have brought home many valuable goods. But wars never end, and we need more of you to participate!

iapodian_reform.p: Hail King! We’ve taken over the settlement and looked through their treasuries and armouries. These people have armours, like tunics that are made of iron rings. It is as sturdy as a thorax but still almost as flexible as a tunic!

pontus_reforms_1.p: Mighty lord of Cappadocia on the Pontos, Mithras praises you! Now that you have shown the Greeks on the coasts of the Pontos Euxeinos how powerful you are, the production of warships has begone.

pontus_reforms_2.p: Chaire, Basileios! Let Zeus and Mithras attest how splendidly you have led our kingdom, how great our wealth has become and how strong our army.

pontus_reforms_3.p: Chaire, mighty Basileios, ruler of the land, mightiest of all the men in mother Asia! By Kybele and Athena, your greatness knows no bounds. The poets are already writing verses about your great victory against the western Barbarians.

rhodes_reforms_1.p: Greetings, Strategos! Warfare beyond our Rhodian shore has changed, and it is time to adapt! A new, large, and oval-shaped shield has spread throughout Hellas and Asia.

rhodes_reforms_2.p: Messengers: Demos and Boule of the Rhodians, hear us out! We bring Aspis shields from Greece, to be carried by cavalry! > > People: WHAT!?

selge_reforms_1.p: Esteemed Nobles of Selge, hear me out! We stand here, on our beautiful plain in the Pisidian mountains, independent, strong and unmatched in bravery.

selge_reforms_2.p: Esteemed council of Selge, today is a glorious day. Our officers have worked hard to make this day reality, and now here, in front of you, stand our first riders who can fight with a Hoplite shield from horseback.

sparta_reforms_1.p: After the success of Alexander and his successors, to which the Greek city states found no answer, the latter began to consider to retrain their Hoplites to fight as Macedonian style pikemen.

thureophoroi_reforms.p: Hail, glorious king of Kabyle. Your wisdom is unparalleled! You have united the Greeks and the Thracians under your rule and your forces grow ever stronger.
